capabilities: Draw and highlight over notes in reading view
Add hand-drawn shapes, lines and arrows
Select, restyle, move, duplicate and reorder ink
Save each note's ink to a separate JSON file
Hide ink or bring back ink from rewritten paragraphs
extras: Ink only syncs between devices if the sync tool syncs .json files; several device setups (Android, Windows pen, iPhone, Linux) are listed as untested. The plugin makes no network requests and has no dependencies.
problem: Marking up a note by hand, such as circling, highlighting or sketching, normally means editing the Markdown itself, which changes the note.

relations.evidence: With Obsidian Sync, turn on Settings → Sync → Sync all other types on every device.

summary: Drawing and highlighting layer for reading view that keeps ink in separate JSON files so the Markdown note is never changed.
